limits.en: Unity Personal: free for hobbyists, individuals and small teams with under $200K revenue/funding in the prior 12 months; publish to web, desktop, AR/VR and mobile; 1,000 monthly AI credits.

keyLimits.en: Free for individuals/small teams under $200K revenue or funding in the prior 12 months; 1,000 monthly AI credits.
Required for businesses with over $200K in annual revenue/funding; adds console and Apple Vision Pro publishing, 2,000 monthly AI credits, expedited support.
Required for businesses exceeding $25M annual revenue; adds cloud/on-prem build automation, read-only source code access, 3,000 monthly AI credits, dedicated support.
For non-gaming/entertainment applications at companies with over $1M in finances; includes industry-specific solution toolkits.

cautions.en: Revenue/funding thresholds gate which plan is legally required (Personal under $200K, Pro under $25M, Enterprise above), a licensing mechanic distinct from feature-based tiering.

capabilities.en: Real-time engine for building games, interactive applications, and 3D/AR/VR experiences, publishing to web, desktop, mobile, and consoles (Pro+).
Includes a monthly allowance of AI credits across all tiers (1,000 on Personal, up to 3,000 on Enterprise).

limitations.en: Console and Apple Vision Pro publishing require Unity Pro or above; not available on the free Personal tier.
Mandatory upgrade to Pro once a project/company crosses the $200K revenue or funding threshold, even if usage otherwise stays modest.

reason.en: Free/open-source 3D tool with overlapping real-time and game-content creation use cases.

missingAlternatives.name: Unreal Engine
missingAlternatives.reason: The primary direct competitor real-time/game engine, absent from the catalogue.

missingAlternatives.name: Godot
missingAlternatives.reason: Free, open-source game engine competitor increasingly compared to Unity, not present in the catalogue.

unknowns: Annual per-month equivalent for Unity Pro ($192.50) was calculated from the stated $2,310/year figure, not shown as an explicit monthly-equivalent line on the page.
